name: Fibonacci-dp
statement:
1. You are given a number n.
2. You are required to print the nth element of fibonnaci sequence.

Note -> Notice precisely how we have defined the fibonnaci sequence
0th element -> 0
1st element -> 1
2nd element -> 1
3rd element -> 2
4th element -> 3
5th element -> 5
6th element -> 8
outputFormat: A number representing the nth element of fibonnaci sequence
